groups.title: Sync speed
groups.note: The defaults are tuned to stay under X's rate limits. Change them only if syncs fail or run too slowly.

groups.title: FxTwitter
groups.note: Cookie-free post lookups that don't use your X session. Your login is still used for protected accounts and anything FxTwitter can't answer.

groups.title: Check
groups.note: Checks saved tweets and retries unavailable tweets. Optionally include a rolling share of quoted and thread tweets.

groups.title: Database
groups.note: Memory the local database may use. Larger values can speed up big archives.

groups.title: Developer
groups.note: Only for testing a second TweetNook install against this archive.

descriptions.auth.auth_token: Your Twitter/X authentication token. See README
descriptions.sync.collections: Which collections Sync now and scheduled syncs save: bookmarks, likes, your tweets. Threads, media, link previews, and tags then run as usual.
descriptions.database.cache_size_kb: Cache target for each database connection.
descriptions.database.mmap_size_bytes: How much of the database can be read through memory mapping.
descriptions.sync.max_retries: Tries again when X rate-limits a page of tweets.
descriptions.sync.backoff_base: Wait before the first retry; it doubles each time.
descriptions.sync.detail_max_retries: Tries again when X rate-limits a single tweet.
descriptions.sync.detail_backoff_base: Wait before the first retry; it doubles each time.
descriptions.sync.cooldown_threshold: Rate-limit errors in a row before a long pause.
descriptions.sync.timeout: Give up on a slow request after this long.
descriptions.sync.max_linked_depth: How far to follow quoted tweets and linked posts from saved tweets and their author's thread. 0 turns this off.
descriptions.sync.reply_linked_depth: Also save tweets quoted or linked in other people's replies to saved conversations, one hop only.
descriptions.sync.reply_linked_limit: Unique quoted or linked tweets to fetch from replies per sync or thread expansion. Failed lookups count toward the limit.
descriptions.web.fetch_avatars: When a profile picture isn't saved yet, the server downloads it from X the first time it's shown and keeps a copy. When off, only saved avatars appear.
descriptions.web.avatar_cache_limit_enabled: Each week, remove the least recently used avatars once the cache is over its limit.
descriptions.web.analytics_refresh_time: When Analytics statistics are rebuilt, in the server's local time. Takes effect after a restart.
descriptions.web.dev_replay_source: Developer tool. Lets a separate TweetNook test install started with --dev-tools replay this archive's saved Twitter/X responses and media instead of contacting X. Read-only and protected by the Web password; refused when no Web password is set.
descriptions.web.host: Use 0.0.0.0 to let other devices on your network connect.
descriptions.schedule.enabled: Run sync automatically from the always-on Web service.
descriptions.schedule.cadence: Run every N hours, every day, every week, or every month.
descriptions.schedule.every_hours: Hours between runs when the hourly cadence is selected.
descriptions.schedule.time: Local or configured-zone time for daily, weekly, and monthly runs.
descriptions.schedule.randomize_time: Add a random delay after the selected run time by default.
descriptions.schedule.random_offset_min_hours: Smallest added delay in hours; 0 keeps the selected time.
descriptions.schedule.weekday: Weekday for weekly runs, where Monday is zero.
descriptions.schedule.day_of_month: Preferred calendar day for monthly runs.
descriptions.schedule.timezone: IANA time zone name, or local for the system time zone.
descriptions.check.enabled: Check that saved tweets are still on X, retry unavailable ones, and keep community note versions. Needs FxTwitter. While off, sync retries unavailable tweets.
descriptions.check.cadence: How often automatic checks run. Weekly by default.
descriptions.check.time: When the check starts, in the schedule's time zone.
descriptions.check.weekday: Day of the week for weekly checks.
descriptions.check.day_of_month: Day for monthly checks, clamped to the month's last day.
descriptions.check.context_enabled: Include a rolling share of quoted, thread, and other context tweets in each check. Off by default. Quotes returned with saved tweets are still checked.
descriptions.check.context_days: Quoted, thread, and other context tweets are each checked once per this many days, spread across runs at the selected check frequency. Saved tweets are checked every run.
descriptions.check.detail_budget: Most tweets the check may look up with your login, for protected accounts and results FxTwitter can't confirm. 0 uses FxTwitter only.
descriptions.fxtwitter.enabled: Look up posts through FxTwitter first when enriching imported tweets and during the check. While off, the check doesn't run.
descriptions.fxtwitter.base_url: The public service, or the address of your own FxEmbed install.
descriptions.fxtwitter.concurrency: Lookups in flight at once. The public service allows about 1,000 a minute.
descriptions.fxtwitter.timeout: Give up on a slow FxTwitter request after this long.
descriptions.activity.max_runs: Maximum number of completed command histories to retain.
descriptions.activity.retention_days: Maximum age of completed command histories.
